itemTags.ore: Dug up by Mining; smelt it into ingots.
itemTags.metal: Metalwork: smelted and smithed into bars, tools and weapons.
itemTags.ingot: A smelted bar; Smithing turns it into tools, weapons and parts.
itemTags.wood: Cut from trees; used for building and crafting.
itemTags.fuel: Burned to keep a furnace or a fire going.
itemTags.food: Heroes eat this to restore HP when their health runs low.
itemTags.drink: Carried in the drink slot; drunk as work starts, one lasts 10 work cycles. Drinks never heal.
itemTags.raw: Uncooked: Cooking makes it into a meal.
itemTags.meat: From animals; cook it before eating.
itemTags.grain: A crop grown on Fields, for baking.
itemTags.fruit: Picked from trees and bushes; eaten or pressed into drinks.
itemTags.berry: A small fruit picked from bushes.
itemTags.potion: Brewed by Alchemy; carried as a consumable and drunk when its moment comes.
itemTags.elixir: Drunk as a fight starts; one lasts 10 fights, and different elixirs stack.
itemTags.material: Used to make other things or to pay for building.
itemTags.gem: A rare stone found while mining.
itemTags.construction: Used to build stations and buildings.
itemTags.seed: Planted to grow a crop or a tree; it is spent when sown.
itemTags.tool: Held in a hand so a hero can work a Token that needs it.
itemTags.trap: Set to catch things while the hero works.
itemTags.bait: Carried in a consumable slot; one is spent per catch, and it changes what bites.
itemTags.weapon: Held in a hand for fighting; the weapon decides the combat skill used.
itemTags.bow: Shoots arrows, carried as a consumable.
itemTags.arrow: Shot from a bow; one is spent per shot.
itemTags.ammo: Spent by a weapon as it fires.
itemTags.armour: Worn for protection: it resists some kinds of damage.
itemTags.shield: Held in the off hand beside a weapon, never swung.

skillPurpose.melee: Fights up close with blades, axes and hammers, or barehanded. Strong against Ranged, weak against Stealth. A hero's best combat skill sets their health.
skillPurpose.ranged: Fights at a distance with bows, shooting arrows from the Bank. Strong against Magic, weak against Melee. A hero's best combat skill sets their health.
skillPurpose.magic: Fights with staves, wands and tomes. Strong against Stealth, weak against Ranged. A hero's best combat skill sets their health.
skillPurpose.stealth: Fights from the shadows with daggers. Strong against Melee, weak against Magic. A hero's best combat skill sets their health.
skillPurpose.mining: Mines ore, stone and gems from veins, for Smithing, Crafting and Construction.
skillPurpose.forestry: Fells trees for logs, sap and bark, for Construction, Crafting and fuel.
skillPurpose.fishing: Catches fish and finds from the water, for Cooking and Crafting.
skillPurpose.farming: Plants and harvests crops, fruit, herbs and saplings, for Cooking, Alchemy and Forestry.
skillPurpose.smithing: Smelts ingots and forges tools, weapons and metal armour for heroes.
skillPurpose.crafting: Makes rope, cloth, glass, leather gear and the everyday parts other skills need.
skillPurpose.cooking: Cooks food that heals heroes in fights, and drinks that help them work.
skillPurpose.alchemy: Brews potions heroes use in fights and at work.
skillPurpose.construction: Builds stations and buildings on Foundations, and takes down marked Tokens.
skillPurpose.fletching: Arrows, bows and hunting gear, made and tuned by hand.
skillPurpose.faith: Shrines, altars and wards that bless the heroes and Tokens around them.
skillPurpose.summoning: Raising thralls and spirits that fight in a hero's place.
skillPurpose.enchanting: Binding gems and dust into gear to make it more than it was.
skillPurpose.crime: Locks, contraband and the things other people would rather keep.
skillPurpose.taming: Beasts of burden that harvest, haul and graze unattended.
skillPurpose.science: Laboratories that convert goods in bulk into other materials.
